audit_title: SILLA Hybrid NLP Engine - Formal Final Audit & Verification Report

query_set_breakdown.exclusion_notes: No queries were excluded. All 20 queries were evaluated uniformly across all models.

precision_at_1.description: Measures whether the very first recommended recipe is an exact relevant hit. Evaluated over 14 in-catalog queries.

precision_at_3.description: Measures relevance density in top 3 slots. Note: For single-target queries (|GT|=1), the maximum possible P@3 is 1/3 (0.3333).

recall_at_3.description: Measures proportion of known relevant recipes retrieved in top 3.

mrr_at_3.formula: MRR@3 = (1 / N_valid) * sum_{i=1}^{N_valid} (1 / rank_i*) where 1 <= rank_i* <= 3, else 0
mrr_at_3.description: Mean Reciprocal Rank restricted to top 3 retrieved results. Properly named MRR@3.

out_of_catalog_rejection_rate.description: Measures accuracy of rejecting non-food, sweets, burgers, and out-of-catalog items over 6 negative queries.

false_acceptance_count.definition: Number of negative queries where a model passed threshold and returned 1 or more recipes (Type I Error).

false_rejection_count.definition: Number of valid in-catalog queries where a model returned 0 recipes due to threshold cutoff (Type II Error).

improvement_derivation.mathematical_explanation: Relative gain = (1.0000 - 0.1429) / 0.1429 * 100% = +599.79% (~ +600%). Absolute gain = +85.71 percentage points.

contradictory_queries_audit.policy: Queries with fundamental culinary contradictions (e.g. Koshari + Seafood, Savory Bechamel + Jam/Chocolate) must NOT return naive partial matches. They are strictly intercepted as REJECTED_CONTRADICTORY with zero recipe suggestions and an explicit clarification prompt.
